text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a successful debut, Symboli<n>Rudolf sets her
sights on the Saudi<n>Arabia R.C. to ensure that she
acquits<n>herself well in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even after the race is over, she<n>upholds her pride
as the Emperor and<n>the student council president
by<n>taking both her press interviews and<n>student
council duties in stride.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Such a capable Umamusume hardly<n>has to rely on
a trainer at all, but in the<n>name of our shared
dream, I resolve<n>to do everything I can to support
her if<n>she needs it.
